name: Yunita Siregar
bio:
Yunita Siregar, A.Md., SE (born June 19, 1994) is an Indonesian actress and model.

She started her career in the entertainment world by becoming a finalist in the GoGirl! Look event in 2010. After that, she entered the world of acting by playing the role of Aqila in the soap opera Love in Paris in 2012.
